usage: deskops edit review [-h] [--root ROOT] selector field value

Edit one review field.

positional arguments:
  selector     Review selector. Selectors accept an exact id, filename, stem,
               or unique slug fragment where supported.
  field        Model field name to update; hyphens are accepted for
               underscores.
  value        New field value, parsed like an SLDB field value.

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Target repository root.
